text:
Linda initially creates an OpenGL application using glBegin(), glVertex(), and glEnd() to draw several geometric primitives. The application is later improved by adding keyboard and mouse interaction through GLUT callbacks and by converting the graphical data into vertex arrays.

Explain how these improvements change the structure, interactivity, and rendering efficiency of the OpenGL application. 

In your answer, discuss:

• how vertices and geometric primitives are used to construct graphical objects;

• how GLUT callback functions allow the program to respond to keyboard or mouse events; and

• why vertex arrays can be more efficient than repeatedly specifying vertices using glBegin() and glEnd().

Support your explanation using appropriate OpenGL or GLUT functions discussed in Modules 1–4.
